# Savvo — AI Relationship Manager

> Keep every connection alive. Savvo is an AI-powered personal CRM built for founders, VCs, and professional networkers.

## What Savvo Does

Savvo helps professionals manage their network relationships. Users type natural language notes about people they meet, and AI extracts structured contact data (name, company, role, follow-ups). Every contact gets a health score that tracks relationship freshness — green means active, red means going cold. Daily digest emails remind users who needs attention.

## Key Features

- **Natural Language Contact Capture**: Type messy meeting notes, AI extracts name, company, job title, how you met, and next steps
- **Relationship Health Scores**: Color-coded scores (green/yellow/orange/red) based on last contact date
- **Semantic Search**: Search contacts by meaning, not just keywords ("who was the fintech person at the conference?")
- **Daily Digest Emails**: Morning summary of relationships that need attention
- **AI Follow-Up Drafts**: One-tap personalized outreach messages
- **LinkedIn QR Code Import**: Scan LinkedIn QR codes to add contacts
- **CSV & Google Contacts Import**: Bring your existing network
- **Google Calendar Sync**: Auto-detect meetings and attendees
- **Relationship Graph**: Visual network map showing connections
- **AI Intro Suggestions**: Discover high-value introductions across your network

## Pricing

- **Free**: 50 contacts, health scores, weekly digest, 5 semantic searches/month
- **Pro**: $8/month (launch price $5/month) — unlimited contacts, daily digest, unlimited search, all AI features
- **Team**: $12/user/month — coming soon, shared graphs and intro requests

## Who It's For

- Startup founders managing investor, partner, and hire relationships
- Venture capitalists tracking portfolio founders and dealflow
- Community builders maintaining large professional networks
- Sales professionals who value relationship-first selling

## Technology

Built with Next.js, Supabase (PostgreSQL + pgvector), OpenAI for extraction and embeddings, Stripe for payments. Hosted on Vercel. All data encrypted, row-level security on all tables, no data sharing with third parties.
